card.name: Symmetry and chirality physics prose
card.fires_on: Scattered words in physics and chemistry text about symmetry breaking, antimatter, electron EDM and chirality, such as 'breaks', 'the', 'a' or 'for' just before a symmetry or new-physics term. Also fires partway through words like vial or chiral.

modes.label: Symmetry-breaking phrasing
modes.description: Verbs and small linking words leading into symmetry or new-physics terms.
modes.example: If the reason is that some undiscovered particle interaction<< breaks>> the symmetry between matter and antimatter,

modes.label: Chirality and stereochemistry
modes.description: Words inside or just before chiral or enantiomer terms.

modes.label: Unrelated word parts
modes.description: Pieces of words or numbers in unrelated text.
modes.example: push the needle through the rubber top. Push down on the plunger to push air into the vial. - Turn the v<<ial>> upside down

card.writes: It suppresses stereo- and cis-type prefixes, so it seems to steer the model away from stereochemistry words.
card.plain: It fires on physics and chemistry text about symmetry and mirror-image molecules, mostly on small words just before such terms.
